sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 11.07.2020.
A s per the prosecution case, on 11.07.2020 at about 10:30 p.m. the accused committed the sexual assault with the complainant and some other minor girls and committed rape upon the survivor children.
The present applicant is the grandmother of the survivor child No.1 and she received Rs.20,000/- from the main accused.
On the basis of aforesaid allegation, FIR has been registered against the present applicant alongwith co-accused.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the appellant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
It is further submitted that in the pressure and threat of co-accused Pyare Miyan, the appellant sent the to co- accused Pyare Miyan's flat.
The applicant is the grandmother of the prosecutrix.
She has no role to play in the crime.
The appellant is a lady aged about 70 years.
She has no criminal past.
The applicant is in custody since 11.07.2020.
The charge sheet has been filed and the conclusion of the trial will take time.
On the basis of aforesaid submissions, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.

Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer for bail and prays for its rejection on the ground that co-accused Pyare Miyan had sexually exploited the Prosecutrix with the help of present applicant.
It is further submitted that previously applicant has approached this Court for grant of bail by filing CRA No. 3532/2021 which has already been dismissed on merits vide order dated 10.01.2022.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and the allegation that the appellant is also involved in the sex racket and she also sent the prosecutrix who was minor to co-accused Pyare Miyan's flat where co-accused Pyare Miyan committed rape upon her and the facts that her previous application for bail by way of CRA No. 3532/2021 vide order dated 10.01.2022 and there is no change in the circumstances, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the applicant.
Hence, the instant bail application is dismissed.

(RAJENDRA KUMAR (VERMA)) JUDGE Amitabh Rabiya Bi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/117121187/
